When their charismatic classmate vanishes without a trace on the night of the annual summer festival, a tight-knit group of friends refuses to accept the town's hasty conclusion of a runaway. As they retrace her final footsteps, they uncover a labyrinth of dark local legends and chilling secrets that suggest she was taken by something far more sinister than human hands. Driven by loyalty and a desperate need for the truth, the teens find themselves racing against time to pierce the veil of a decades-old conspiracy before one of them becomes the next victim.
